meta.note: duration·aspect는 프롬프트 본문이 아니라 힉스필드 생성 파라미터로 설정

look.palette: marble white + gold + jewel-tone stained glass; flashback = cold moonlight low-key
look.grammar: Lionella CU = subtle low angle (power); perpetrator reactions = eye-level to high angle; shallow DOF on all dialogue CUs; no on-screen text

screen_direction_lock.rule: EP01 전체 불변. OTS 왕복 시에도 유지.

shotlist.audio: VO: Five years ago today, I became Empress here.

shotlist.cam: handheld drift + insert on hidden hand
shotlist.audio: VO: The poison came from my husband.

shotlist.dir: Alexis upper frame, Lionella foreground back
shotlist.audio: Alexis: I grant you the right to choose your own consort.

shotlist.cam: slow lateral track along the line, POV-adjacent
shotlist.audio: VO: You first. I will kill you slowly.
Alexis(off): If one of them holds your heart, speak now.

shotlist.dir: Lionella moves R→L past the line

shotlist.cam: locked OTS pair, subtle low on Lionella
shotlist.audio: L: Have you ever been married? / C: ...Once. She died five years ago.

shotlist.cam: insert then rise to faces, hold
shotlist.audio: L: Tell me. What did she look like?
VO: Next — the selection becomes a confession game.
